nodes.label: Hashed Session Tokens
nodes.rationale: Random tokens stored hashed, HttpOnly/SameSite=Lax/Secure cookie, 30-day expiry

nodes.label: SQLite via node:sqlite
nodes.rationale: Single-file DB with no native dependency, works with and without Docker

nodes.label: ORIGIN env var
nodes.rationale: Passkeys are bound to this exact domain; changing it breaks existing passkeys

nodes.label: Passkey-only Authentication
nodes.rationale: Passwordless; single-user instance with multiple passkeys (one per device)

nodes.label: HTTPS Reverse Proxy Requirement
nodes.rationale: HTTPS required for passkeys and PWA install; Host header must be forwarded for Next.js server action CSRF check

nodes.label: Initialization Setup Code
nodes.rationale: Code disappears after first passkey so nobody else can register on a public instance
